title: Buddy Petit holding long notes
summary: Miller says Buddy Petit could hold a note long, like F, though not high.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: stuff like stuff stuff like stuff stuff like stuff Who played the longest on one breath?
Did anybody feature real long phrases all on one breath?
Yeah, Buddy Petit could hold a note long but he wouldn't be high. He would hold a note like F. She used to do that in the band and play a whole chord to the blues. Why are they holding that note?
What's that F at the bottom of the staff or right above the staff?
Oh yeah, this F. She used to be playing.
